 Cuba vs Grenada Preview & Prediction | 2026-27 CONCACAF Nations League
 by Alex Lawes · 14 November 2026 at 6:05 pm 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 The 2026-27 CONCACAF Nations League continues with a clash between Cuba and Grenada at Estadio La Polar in Havana. 
 Kick-off date/time: 
 16 November 2026 at 8:00 pm 
 How to watch on TV & online:  UK – Some matches may be streamed live on CONCACAF GO and their associated YouTube channel / USA – Some matches are televised on FOX Sports channels
 Cuba vs Grenada Prediction 
 Ranked 163rd in the world by FIFA, Cuba come into this one on the back of a 7-1 demolition at the hands of Bonaire the other day. They have shown improvement and they are now unbeaten in their last nine matches.
 Grenada managed to defeat Saint Kitts and Nevis by three goals to two in their most recent outing. The Grenadians have won two and lost three of their five matches in League B of the CONCACAF Nations League in this international break.
 Cuba have found form in this calendar year and they will again be expected to get themselves another victory in Central America.
 Cuba vs Grenada Tip:  Cuba to win
